coverage.finding: Top-left page number '126' with a superscript letter and a stop. The letter has an ascender and is consistent with 'b' and with the supplied label fol. 126b. The candidate rightly keeps the residual uncertainty.

Single line of continuation text. The candidate's reading agrees with the source as far as legible: 'ff.1-103(with a ´sobhapattra between ff.18 & 19), inc., down to āśvāsa v, 61. I.O. 7270-2.' The '&' resembles 'r' and 'I.O.' resembles '1.0.', and both uncertainties are recorded. The left-pointing arrow at the gutter is correctly attached. The link to fol. 127 √c.180 (extent 104) is plausible and stays probable.

Continuation line. The parenthetical after 'ff.1-63' visibly has two numeral elements, like '3/4' or a stacked fraction, after an abbreviation read as 'ln.' or 'h.'. The candidate literal 'ln. 3[?]' drops the second visible element, so a change is proposed. The arrow link to fol. 127 √c.108(3) (extent 62) stays probable.

Ticked entry √c.129(5). The heavy overwriting at the start of 'Narasiṃha…' is noted. The caret sits under the comma after 'candrikā'. The date:extent:lines:script column 'n.d.:13:26:d' has a lowercase final 'd', which is correctly preserved. 'ends at' is written closely as 'endsat'.
Interlinear '(anon.)' above 'candrikā', keyed by the caret. It is correctly merged into r004. Treating it as a whole-record 'author' field is an interpretation, so a change is proposed.

Ticked entry √d.332 with column 'n.d.:158:9:D' (uppercase D). The text agrees with the source. 'MSS' may be followed by a stop before 'of'; this is too small to assert. The arrow pair near the gutter is noted.
